{{Quote|Ovair's triumph over darkness was celebrated, and the Jedi Council assumed that all was well. The question no one asked was this: 'Why would Naga Sadow's spirit seek vengeance, specifically against Master Ovair?'&nbsp;|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Time7" />}}
'''Barel Ovair''' was a prestigious [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi historian|scholar]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. He was the scion of a respected [[Ovair family|line]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] who were all secretly [[Spy/Legends|spies]] working for [[Tenebrae|the Emperor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Ovair took [[Eison Gynt]], a highly skilled [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and a fourth-generation [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], as his apprentice, but abandoned him during a [[Mission to Yavin 4|mission]] to the [[Naga Sadow's tomb|tomb]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].

When Ovair returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] alone [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] afterward, he claimed that Gynt had been [[Death/Legends|killed]]. However, Gynt resurfaced on Coruscant [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, possessed by Sadow's [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] and determined to kill Ovair. Ovair defeated Gynt in [[Duel on Coruscant (Inter–Sith Wars Period)|combat]], slaying him, and was lauded as a hero for his triumph. It was not until many [[Time/Legends|years]] later that the Jedi historian [[Gnost-Dural]] connected Ovair and his family line to the [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Sith Emperor]].

==Biography==
===Life as a Jedi===
{{Quote|Having a similar heritage, the venerated Jedi scholar, Master Barel Ovair, took Gynt as his apprentice. Together, Ovair and Gynt traveled the galaxy, studying the mysteries of the Force.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Time7" />}}
[[File:Sithlords_valley.jpg|thumb|left|240px|Ovair and Gynt visiting the Valley of the Dark Lords on Korriban]]
Barel Ovair was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] from a respected [[Ovair family|family line]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Secretly, he and his family were [[Spy/Legends|spies]] working for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the outbreak of the [[Great Galactic War]]. In his role as a Jedi Master, Ovair took a talented young [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] named [[Eison Gynt]], a fourth-generation Jedi, as his apprentice. As fellow [[Jedi historian|Jedi scholars]], Ovair and Gynt traveled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], studying [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and taking on increasingly daring tasks for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. One of their missions took them to the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]],<ref name="Time7" /> the resting place of many [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

Their career together culminated with an [[Mission to Yavin 4|ambitious mission]]<ref name="Time7" /> in [[3756 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 7: Peace for the Republic?|int=Timeline 7: Peace for the Republic?}} places Barel Ovair and [[Eison Gynt]]'s [[Mission to Yavin 4|mission]] 103 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], which ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' places in [[3653 BBY]].</ref> to explore the [[Naga Sadow's tomb|tomb]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] on<ref name="Time7" /> the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. The mission was ostensibly to rid the temple of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] energies for the good of the Order, but in truth, Ovair was under orders by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] of the Sith Empire to eliminate any remnant of Sadow's power, which the [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] viewed as a potential threat to his planned invasion of the Republic. During the mission, Ovair and Gynt were attacked by [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the moon, and were forced to go deep within the tomb. Ovair returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] later without his Padawan, incoherent and injured. After recovering from his ordeal, Ovair reported to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] that Gynt had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the mission. However, Gynt was in fact still alive and had fallen under the influence of Sadow's [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]].<ref name="Time7" />

===Vengeance and legacy===
{{Quote|Possessed by the dark spirit of Naga Sadow, Gynt attacked his former master in broad daylight. The brutal battle between the two was staged with all of the Republic watching.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Time7" />}}
[[File:OvairVsGynt-TORT7.jpg|thumb|right|230px|Eison Gynt attacks Barel Ovair on Coruscant.]]
Gynt resurfaced on Coruscant several [[Time/Legends|years]] after the failed mission to Yavin 4, dressed in [[Sith apparel|Massassi warrior robes]] and possessed by the spirit of Sadow. After finding his former Master, Gynt [[Duel on Coruscant (Inter–Sith Wars Period)|attacked him]] in full view of the public. While Gynt's borrowed dark-side [[Force power/Legends|abilities]] were formidable, the undercover [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] defeated and killed his former Padawan. Ovair was interviewed by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] after the [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], but his triumph was praised, and he came under no suspicion.<ref name="Time7" />

Indeed, he was hailed as a hero by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for his actions. Over a century later, Jedi historian [[Gnost-Dural]] questioned why the spirit of Sadow would have sought vengeance against Ovair specifically, and made the connection between Ovair and the Sith. He realized that Ovair and his Jedi ancestors were in fact spies working on behalf of the [[Emperor/Legends|Sith Emperor]]. The historian deduced that Ovair had used Gynt to draw out Sadow's spirit to eliminate it prior to the invasion of the Republic.<ref name="Time7" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|What other acts of dark subterfuge were Ovair and his family involved in?|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Time7" />}}
Ovair was ostensibly a respected Jedi scholar, though he concealed his true allegiances so well that they were not discovered for centuries; even when driven half-insane by his ordeal on Yavin 4, Ovair did not allow his cover to slip. Alongside his Padawan Gynt, Ovair grew more and more ambitious in his expeditions across the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], culminating in the mission to Yavin 4. Ovair had fair skin with [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], although his eyes would turn orange-yellow when his corruption by the dark side of the Force was revealed.<ref name="Time7" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Ovair's mission on Yavin 4 was not for the Jedi&mdash;it was on behalf of his true master, the dark Emperor of the Sith. The Emperor knew the spirits of the ancient Sith Lords could be a threat to his power when he returned to the known galaxy a century later&hellip;|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Time7" />}}
[[File:Ovair_council.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ovair concealed his true heritage from even the Jedi High Council.]]
When the spirit of Naga Sadow possessed Gynt, who had been considered the most promising Padawan in the Jedi Order at the time of his selection, Ovair was still able to overcome the formidable dark powers of Sadow occupying the body of such a talented Jedi. Ovair's skills at subterfuge were sufficient to conceal his identity until years later when reviewed by Jedi historian Gnost-Dural; he concealed his strength in the dark side even as he resided within the walls of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Ovair wielded a purple [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Time7" />

==Behind the scenes==
Barel Ovair was introduced in ''[[Timeline 7: Peace for the Republic?]]'', a video released on [[April 16]], [[2010]] as part of the ''[[Galactic Timeline]]'' series of lore videos published on the [https://www.swtor.com official website] for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Time7" />
